newsitem.title: UK: UK air cargo agent Pace re-opens Manchester office.
newsitem.headline: UK air cargo agent Pace re-opens Manchester office.

text.p: UK cargo general sales agent Pace Airline Services, said it has re-opened a sales and reservations office at Manchester Airport after an absence of more than two years.
It added that this was due to increasing demand from local and north-west England regional customers.
Along with Manchester, in February 1995 Pace closed its London Heathrow and Glasgow offices to locate all central reservations operations in Birmingham.
With effect from April 1, the company said it will transfer its headquarters and central reservations office to Longford, Middlesex, near Heathrow.
The new Manchester operations will be managed by northern regional director Allan Burck and reservations manager Sarah Strutt.
Pace also has offices in Glasgow, Dublin, Chicago, Kiev and Beijing.

Its cargo GSA clients include Air China, Britannia Airways, CSA Czech Airlines, Korean Airlines, Malev Hungarian Airlines, TAP-Air Portugal, Sabena, Ukraine International Airlines and United Airlines.
